review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and both task keys remain stable. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical specification input, not a human Decision; an empty frozen human-decision input is therefore consistent with ready and no blocking reasons. This does not resolve B: its material unresolved DEC-001 must block at decisions before later prerequisites. The writable scope covers message construction, public/internal option declarations, normalization, option-key filtering and the required runtime/type regressions. The supplied generic merge, forwarding, barrel and hook declaration consumers support inspection-only ownership without mandatory edits. Distribution declarations are build outputs, not separately maintained owners. The configured test pipeline distinguishes AVA/tsx runtime checks from the test-d TypeScript project. TASK-IMPLEMENT and independent TASK-VERIFY, with verification dependent on implementation and both covering all required acceptance criteria, are consistent with the PRD. The designated agents have the relevant supplied active project-scoped trusted claims, roles and capacity; eligibility does not rely on persona or pending claims. The selected verifier can satisfy the stated independent read-only planning-review prerequisite. Repository identity/base commit and release fingerprints agree across Gold and preview; the documented manifest/evaluation, PRD-trimming and source/bundle digest domains explain their differing fingerprints. Historical scoped attestations are supplied provenance, not attestations created by this review. No candidate evidence informed this assessment. I reviewed the supplied data without tools or execution and accepted Service-calculated digest bindings without independently recomputing them. Approval concerns the Gold expectation, not implementation success, task dispatch or release authorization.
